description: Uncorrected BAMF masks can label small regions apart from the main tumour. In C3N-00313 the mask marks a small tumour region in the right kidney and a tiny cyst region inside the left-kidney tumour, besides that tumour. In C3N-02723 it marks small tumour fragments in the left kidney, away from the large right-kidney tumour. Whether these regions are real lesions is not documented.
inspectedScope: The atlas previews of C3N-00313 and C3N-02723 (axial, zoomed axial, coronal and sagittal views through the centred label). Other cases were not inspected.

evidence.locator: BAMF segmentations of cases C3N-00313 and C3N-02723, drawn on their CT
evidence.note: Cases seen in previews; this is not a count across the release.

detection: Seen in the preview renderings of the BAMF mask on each case's CT.
impact: A per-case lesion count or tumour volume taken from an uncorrected mask includes these regions.
handling: Check small separate regions in uncorrected BAMF masks before counting lesions or measuring volumes; use the radiologist-corrected masks where they exist.
